title: BC Geographical Names Web Service - REST API

operations.description: Gets a list of all feature categories used by the BC Geographical Names Information System (BCGNIS).  Note: there are three levels of classification in the BCGNIS feature taxonomy: classes, categories and types.  A type is a subset of a category, and a category is a subset of a class.

Gets a list of all feature classes used by the BC Geographical Names Information System (BCGNIS).  Note: there are three levels of classification in the BCGNIS feature taxonomy: classes, categories and types.  A type is a subset of a category, and a category is a subset of a class.

Gets a list of all feature types used by the BC Geographical Names Information System (BCGNIS).  Note: there are three levels of classification in the BCGNIS feature taxonomy: classes, categories and types.  A type is a subset of a category, and a category is a subset of a class.
Get information about the geographical feature with the specified featureId.
operations.summary: Get a feature by its featureId

operations.description: Gets a list of all name authorities responsible for naming decisions of the geographical names in the BC Geographical Names Information System (BCGNIS)
Search for information about geographical names which have changed most recently within a specified time window.  Changes may include status cupdates and metadata corrections.
operations.summary: Search for names with metadata changes in a given period
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names changes [PARAMS] by category class date embed feature format from index items output page per sort srs start style to type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about geographical names affected by naming 'decisions' made by the BC Geographical Names Office (naming authority) within the last X days.
operations.summary: Search for names affected by recent naming decision
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names decisions recent [PARAMS] by category class days embed feature format index items output page per sort srs start style type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about geographical names affected by naming 'decisions' made by the BC Geographical Names Office (naming authority) in a given year.
operations.summary: Search for names affected by naming decisions in a given year
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names decisions year [PARAMS] by category class embed feature format index items output page per sort srs start style type year [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about geographical names that correspond to features within a geographic bounding box.  Various options and filter parameters are available to refine the search.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names inside [PARAMS] bbox by category class embed feature format index items output page per sort srs start style type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about geographical names that correspond to features within a geographic area defined by a centre point and a radius.  Various options and filter parameters are available to refine the search.
operations.summary: Search near to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names near [PARAMS] by category class distance embed feature format index items output page per point sort srs start style type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about unofficial geographical names by the text of the name itself.  Various options and filter parameters are available to refine the search.
operations.summary: Search by name, limit to unofficial names only
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names not official search [PARAMS] by category class embed exact feature format index items name output page per sort spelling srs start style type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about official geographical names by the text of the name itself.  Various options and filter parameters are available to refine the search.
operations.summary: Search by name, limit to official names only
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names official search [PARAMS] by category class embed exact feature format index items name output page per sort spelling srs start style type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for information about geographical names by the text of the name itself.  The response will include both official and unofficial names.  Various options and filter parameters are available to refine the search.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names search [PARAMS] by category class embed exact feature format index items name output page per sort spelling srs start style type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get information about the geographical name with the specified nameId.
operations.summary: Get a name by its nameId
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] names [PARAMS] format id name output [SCHEMA]
